form_name: San Francisco Annual Business Registration and Tax Return (Gross Receipts Tax and related business taxes)
filer: Businesses (including self-employed individuals) with San Francisco gross receipts
rule: Annual filing deadline, earlier than the typical April 15 pattern
description: San Francisco's Annual Business Registration and Tax Return for tax year 2025 must be submitted and paid by March 2, 2026 to avoid late penalties - notably earlier than the April 15 pattern most other jurisdictions use. San Francisco has no separate individual wage-earner income tax; this is a business/gross-receipts tax that can apply to self-employed individuals.
authority: Direct fetch of the Treasurer & Tax Collector's Annual Business Registration and Tax Form Instructions this session
